log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Document validation rules for customer onboarding fields, connecting each field’s pattern to a valid example and an error message.","tasks":["Find a field and inspect its validation rule.","Compare the rule with a valid example.","Find the error message presented when a value fails validation."],"relations":["Each row connects one field to its pattern, example and error message.","The example illustrates the pattern; the error message explains the expected input to a user."],"roles":["Field is the row label and lookup key.","Pattern is technical validation syntax.","Example valid is a concrete input value.","Error message is explanatory prose; the column headers identify these distinct roles."],"keep_whole":["Field identifiers, example values, dates, phone numbers, email addresses and other machine-readable tokens should stay whole where space allows.","Regular-expression syntax should remain continuous and preserve every character; arbitrary breaks make it harder to inspect and copy."],"may_wrap":["Error messages can wrap between words and at natural phrase boundaries.","Headers can wrap between words.","Long patterns may need to wrap when width is constrained, although the email expression is especially costly to accommodate on one line."],"same_scale":["All field labels share one visual role, as do all examples and all error messages.","Pattern and error-message columns can be wider than the field column because they contain more complex material."],"h_vs_v":"A viewport-width table avoids horizontal scrolling but forces identifiers, examples and patterns to break, producing tall rows. A wider table preserves meaningful units and supports comparison, at the cost of scrolling across each row; accommodating the entire email pattern on one line requires especially extensive scrolling."},"designs":[{"widths":[100,95,80,84],"strategy":"Fit the viewport with a modest preference for field labels and patterns, accepting forced breaks in technical tokens and tall rows."},{"widths":[147,360,285,320],"strategy":"Use a scrollable, balanced reference layout that keeps field labels and examples whole while giving patterns and prose room to wrap."},{"widths":[147,1095,285,400],"strategy":"Favor uninterrupted inspection of the complete pattern column, including the long email expression, with substantial horizontal scrolling."}]}
